messages.subject: Reminder: paper for discussion on Wednesday
parts:
Hello D-RUGgies,
This is a reminder that we will begin this week's group meeting by discussing the paper "Software Engineering and R Programming: A Call for Research" by Melina Vedoni. Link is here: https://journal.r-project.org/articles/RJ-2021-108/

Please read it before our meeting (Wednesday 10-noon in Shields Library 360 and via Zoom), and come prepared to talk about the place of software engineering tools and practices in R.

See you Wednesday!
-Wes
